method: Read-only source inventory in E:/fair-constitution-app. Read CLAUDE.md, reference-document excerpts, Vue pages, routes, controllers and selected shared components/handlers. No builds, application mutations, DB queries or end-to-end workflow execution. Author-created JSON artifact only.

status_definitions.real: Source exposes actual model/service/engine reads or writes; does not assert live success
status_definitions.partial: A specific unfinished user action verified in page plus handler/controller
status_definitions.merge: Proposed information architecture consolidation; preserve distinct data, access rules and legal functions
status_definitions.contextualize: Retain as task/entity/role detail reached from a clear hub rather than default top-level choice

shared_findings.finding: Most civic/government pages are implemented domain workflows, not empty explainers. Role eligibility, empty context and repeated exposition can mask that implementation.
shared_findings.confidence: high for source, no live execution

shared_findings.finding: PublicSquare/Halls and MatrixCommons are different record/live layers but create competing discussion entrances.
shared_findings.recommendation: Single discussion destination with context and conversation/record views; preserve formal testimony bridge.

shared_findings.finding: Generic institution resolvers discard absent context and can show empty or different destinations; they are aliases, not independent pages.
shared_findings.recommendation: Persist selected jurisdiction/entity in navigation. Enter specific workflow from entity-aware links.

shared_findings.finding: Civic Home names specific elections but sends every item and election calendar event to generic /elections, losing the selected event.
shared_findings.recommendation: Use concrete election hrefs. Apply same check to referendum rows/calendar and session links.
shared_findings.confidence: high; source confirmed, parent agent also observed live links

shared_findings.finding: LiveCivicRoom is partially implemented and should not be demoed as a complete live committee workspace.
shared_findings.recommendation: Consolidate with CommitteeDetail and existing shared live-room implementation.

shared_findings.finding: Juror deliberation entry is an inert button when it becomes enabled.
shared_findings.recommendation: Connect an actual authorized room before including deliberation in demo.

shared_findings.finding: Identity attestation currently records a request without completing verification.
shared_findings.recommendation: Keep optional and outside main demo onboarding; label request outcome accurately.

demo_sequence_proposal: Select a prepared jurisdiction and actor context
See a specific actionable election/petition item in Civic Home
Complete approval vote or petition signature with existing engine write
Show persisted result and public/personal record
Observe concrete legislature/session or committee detail
Use representative/judge/governor role workspaces only in later guided scenarios
